purpose: Credible measured-data discoveries still awaiting file-level profiling, retrieval, rights clearance, or role assignment. Sources already governed by the canonical inventory are removed from the active discovery queue and recorded separately so discovery metadata cannot contradict executed canonical state.

activeDiscoveries.title: AD-STGN for RCA in CMMS — real-world injection molding production-line case
activeDiscoveries.recordUnit: reported process time sample; not assumed to equal one moulding cycle
quality: reported examples include internal bubbles, warpage and incomplete cooling
activeDiscoveries.limitation: The live Mendeley record still describes the industrial injection-moulding case and exposes a Download All control, but its Files section contains no public file entries. Reported sample/channel counts therefore remain metadata only. Exact payload bytes, timestamps/grouping, field semantics, labels and test-sequence length must be inspected before any measured count or benchmark adapter is created.

provenanceChecks.decision: descriptive free-access wording is not treated as an explicit reuse licence or proof that the mirror owner is the original data rights-holder

activeDiscoveries.limitation: The public GitHub repository describes real repeated injection-moulding acquisitions and exposes a 2.4 MB Data.xlsx workbook, but GitHub reports no repository licence and no authoritative original dataset distribution has been located. The historical commit wording 'Molding Machine Free Access Data' is descriptive access language, not an explicit reuse grant. Public mirror availability is not treated as permission for automated ingestion or redistribution. The workbook must remain non-counting until provenance and reuse rights are tied to the original data owner/source; only then should its sheets, units, rows and overlap be profiled.

activeDiscoveries.title: Aspöck/Leiria industrial injection-moulding process-monitoring data reported in Costa 2025 thesis and peer-reviewed Polymers study
activeDiscoveries.license: CC BY applies to the open thesis and journal article; underlying company production-data reuse rights are not stated
activeDiscoveries.recordUnit: one reported cycle-level machine/sensor feature record per injection cycle; not an intra-cycle process waveform unless released payload proves otherwise

scale.collectionDuration: approximately six months of continuous production

activeDiscoveries.reportedCountRelationship: The thesis and later journal paper report different cycle totals over approximately six months. They are treated as related reported scales only; no equality, containment, deduplication, or additive relationship is assumed until the underlying payloads and collection windows are available.
activeDiscoveries.measurementGranularity: The peer-reviewed paper states that 264 sensors each provide one reading per cycle. These are cycle-level process measurements/features, not 264 within-cycle sampled waveforms. If released, they must enter the record-level process-measurement lane unless file inspection demonstrates additional intra-cycle time-series data.
signals: 264 reported cycle-level readings covering temperature, pressure, torque, stage time, force and related machine variables
engineered relative-viscosity proxy in the published modelling workflow
quality: faulty/non-conforming production time-zone labels used for industrial anomaly monitoring
melt-instability or volatile-zone labels preceding quality degradation
activeDiscoveries.dataAvailability: The 2025 Polymers article states that the original contributions are included in the article and that further inquiries can be directed to the corresponding author; no reusable raw production CSV/XLSX payload is publicly attached.
activeDiscoveries.limitation: The Polytechnic Institute of Leiria repository exposes the CC BY thesis and CC BY journal article, not the underlying Aspöck/industrial production CSV/XLSX payload. The thesis reports 71,016 real injection cycles while the later peer-reviewed Polymers paper reports approximately 280,000 cycles from six months of continuous production. The journal describes 264 sensors/features recorded once per cycle, so these must not be inflated into process-waveform counts. Publication licences must not be widened into a licence for company production data, and the two reported totals must not be added or deduplicated by assumption. No cycles, feature cells or waveform values may be counted unless the original dataset is released or the data owner supplies explicit reuse permission and files, after which overlap, record semantics and measurement granularity must be profiled.

activeDiscoveries.title: Injection-moulding state recognition from triaxial accelerometer data
activeDiscoveries.license: CC BY 4.0 applies to the article; underlying recordings are available only by contacting the authors
activeDiscoveries.recordUnit: 100 Hz triaxial accelerometer sample synchronized to PLC state labels
activeDiscoveries.limitation: The study is genuine production monitoring across five injection-moulding machines, but its Data Availability Statement says the authors can be contacted to obtain the study data. The CC BY article licence does not establish an open licence for unpublished recordings. Keep the source as request-only evidence until authorised payload and terms are obtained.

canonicalInventoryManagedSources.note: The canonical inventory already governs this source as an executed-open CC BY 4.0 production-record dataset. It is record-level rather than a high-frequency shot waveform and must not remain in the zero-count discovery queue.

The canonical contract records official Zenodo API CC BY 4.0 evidence and accepts sixteen ENGEL Heating.sv_Zone*.rActualTemp channels in degrees Celsius. Remaining channel semantics can expand this family later but do not make the source an active discovery.

screenedOutDiscoveries.title: Towards a general application programming interface (API) for injection molding machines — supplemental sampling CSVs
screenedOutDiscoveries.reason: The openly licensed supplemental CSVs test acquisition at 2, 33, 50 and 100 Hz, but the study explicitly states that no injection-moulding production runs were performed during the tests and most machine parameter values were constant or zero. These files are instrumentation/API evidence, not moulding-process waveform evidence.
